service.en: Residency and Emirates ID for family (investor or partner sponsor)
service.ar: إقامة وهوية إماراتية للعائلة (كفيل مستثمر أو شريك)
service.ur: خاندان کے لیے رہائش اور ایمریٹس آئی ڈی (سرمایہ کار یا شراکت دار کفیل)

about: An investor or partner sponsor requests a residency permit and Emirates ID for family members.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Sponsor is an investor or partner
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
